verdict.rationale: Svelte is an open-source UI compiler and framework that runs in the user's own project, so it holds no user account data that could be exported. The code users write is already plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript files they own (svelte-docs-1, svelte-docs-4). An "export all my data and leave" story is therefore a category error for this product type. The playground-to-project download (svelte-docs-15) is a project-scaffolding convenience, not a data-portability or exit feature, so it does not make the axis apply.
